info.name: LearningHub — API Quality & Regression Suite (Express/Node)
info.description: Separate smoke and regression suite for the Node.js Express backend under learninghub/backend. Routes are derived from server.ts and actual route modules. Configure baseUrl as the Express origin only. CI scope is GET-only and avoids state-changing operations.

exec: pm.test('Express API response time below smoke threshold (5s)', function () { pm.expect(pm.response.responseTime).to.be.below(5000); });
pm.test('Express API response body is valid JSON when present', function () { if (pm.response.text().length > 0) pm.response.to.be.json; });

item.name: Process Health
item.description: GET /health is defined directly in learninghub/backend/src/server.ts and returns { status: 'ok' } without a database query.

exec: pm.test('Express process health responds HTTP 200', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); });
const body = pm.response.json();
pm.test('Express process health status is ok', function () { pm.expect(body.status).to.equal('ok'); });

item.name: Liveness Probe
item.description: GET /api/v1/health/live is mounted by the Express v1 router and returns an alive status without checking dependencies.

exec: pm.test('Liveness probe responds HTTP 200', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); });
const body = pm.response.json();
pm.test('Liveness probe reports alive', function () { pm.expect(body.status).to.equal('alive'); });
pm.test('Liveness probe provides a timestamp', function () { pm.expect(body.timestamp).to.be.a('string').and.not.empty; });

item.name: Course Categories
item.description: Static category list returned through sendSuccess.

exec: pm.test('Course categories respond HTTP 200', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); });
const body = pm.response.json();
pm.test('Course categories use the success envelope', function () { pm.expect(body.status).to.equal('success'); pm.expect(body.data).to.be.an('array'); });

item.name: AI Models Catalog
item.description: GET /api/v1/ai/models is public in Express routes and returns provider/model metadata using sendSuccess.

exec: pm.test('AI model catalog responds HTTP 200', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); });
const body = pm.response.json();
pm.test('AI model catalog uses the success envelope', function () { pm.expect(body.status).to.equal('success'); pm.expect(body.data).to.be.an('object'); });
pm.test('AI model catalog includes provider metadata', function () { pm.expect(body.data).to.have.property('providers').that.is.an('array'); });

item.name: Curriculum Templates
item.description: GET /api/v1/curriculum/templates is public through optionalAuth and returns { templates } in sendSuccess data.

exec: pm.test('Curriculum templates respond HTTP 200', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); });
const body = pm.response.json();
pm.test('Curriculum templates use the success envelope', function () { pm.expect(body.status).to.equal('success'); pm.expect(body.data).to.be.an('object'); });
pm.test('Curriculum templates payload includes templates', function () { pm.expect(body.data).to.have.property('templates'); });

item.name: Current User — Reject Anonymous Access
item.description: GET /api/v1/auth/me is protected by authenticate; no Bearer token must return 401.

exec: pm.test('Anonymous Express profile request is rejected', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(401); });
const body = pm.response.json();
pm.test('Anonymous profile response uses the error envelope', function () { pm.expect(body.status).to.equal('error'); pm.expect(body).to.have.property('code'); });
